subject: Mutual action outline: kickoff draft + timeline options — please confirm stakeholders
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Long <sarah.long@healthcorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action outline: kickoff draft + timeline options — please confirm stakeholders

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call today. Attached is a lightweight Mutual Action Outline (MAP) capturing the milestones we discussed and two timeline scenarios so your stakeholders can pick what makes sense. Quick summary below and a short ask at the end.

TL;DR (attachments: MAP draft v1 + filled security questionnaire stub)
- Proposed target close windows: Option A (rapid): 6–8 weeks; Option B (conservative): 10–14 weeks.
- Key milestones: discovery -> pilot setup -> performance validation -> legal & procurement -> go/no-go + production cutover.
- Suggested owners: HealthCorp (business sponsor + security), Redwood (technical PM + implementation lead), Procurement (commercial/contracting).
- Dependencies: SOC2 evidence, internal procurement review, sandbox access for integration testing.

Please review the short action grid below and tell us: 1) which timeline option you prefer, and 2) who from your side should be the named owner for each milestone (we highlighted our suggested owners in column C).

Proposed action grid (high-level):
- Milestone 1 — Pilot kickoff: target start: Week 0–1 (Jordan -> Redwood PM)
- Milestone 2 — Data & infra prep: Week 1–2 (HealthCorp data lead)
- Milestone 3 — Pilot run & evaluation: Week 3–4 (Redwood eng lead + HealthCorp tester)
- Milestone 4 — Security & legal sign-off: Week 5–6 (HealthCorp security/procurement)
- Milestone 5 — Go/no-go & production onboarding: Week 6–8 (Joint)

Options for timeline:
- Option A (accelerated): Aim to complete pilot and sign by end of Week 8. Requires fast procurement turnaround and immediate sandbox credentials.
- Option B (conservative): Buffer for procurement and extra validation; target Week 12–14 close.

Asks: 
1) Please confirm which timeline you prefer (A or B)
2) Confirm named stakeholders for Security, Procurement, Business Sponsor, and Technical SME
3) Any blockers we should know about (e.g., procurement PO process, security questionnaire owners)

I’ve cc’d Karthik (technical lead) and Neha (solutions/ops) to help with scoping and dependencies. If it’s helpful, we can schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff next week to walk the internal owners through the plan and agree on the PO/contract timeline.

Thanks — Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: 20260629_JB_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), healthcorp_security_questions_filled.pdf (answers stub)

From: Sarah Long <sarah.long@healthcorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthcorp.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual action outline: kickoff draft + timeline options — please confirm stakeholders

Jordan — appreciate the summary and the draft. The team reviewed quickly and we prefer Option B to give legal and procurement time to loop in our vendors team. A couple quick notes:
- Please add our procurement lead (procurement@healthcorp.com) to the action grid as owner for commercial review — I’ve cc’d them.
- Security will need to validate the filled questionnaire with our InfoSec before sign-off; that will add 2 business weeks typically.
- Can you include a short note on data residency / logging retention in the MAP so our security folks see it upfront?

I’ll follow up internally to confirm the business sponsor (likely Rajesh Mehta) and technical SME. Can you tentatively hold the week of Aug 10 as a conservative pilot start (Option B flow)?

Thanks — Sarah
Head of Data & Analytics | HealthCorp
Phone: +1 (212) 555-0166

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action outline: kickoff draft + timeline options — please confirm stakeholders

Adding a couple of technical clarifications we should surface in the MAP before the kickoff call with HealthCorp:
- Sandbox access: we will need a dedicated S3 bucket + service account with read-only sample data (or a pseudonymized dump) for the initial pilot.
- Model variant: propose starting with the 8-bit quantized variant we discussed — lower cost and meets latency targets for their expected 95th percentile.
- Monitoring & alerts: include a short acceptance criteria for performance (baseline RPS, 95th latency target) so the pilot has measurable pass/fail gates.

I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet with a tech appendix and a short data residency/retention note for the security team to review. Neha — can you add a row to capture PO timing assumptions (typical HealthCorp cadence -> 2–3 weeks after legal review)?

-karthik

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Long <sarah.long@healthcorp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@healthcorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action outline (updated): prefer Option B, requested owners + next steps

Thanks all — quick update following Sarah’s note and Karthik’s input. I’ve updated the MAP draft (attached v1 -> v1.1) with:
- Timeline set to Option B (target pilot start week of 2026-08-10).
- Procurement now listed as owner for "Commercial review & PO" (procurement@healthcorp.com).
- Tech appendix added: sandbox access checklist, model variant recommendation (8-bit), monitoring acceptance criteria.
- Security note: data residency and token retention policy paragraph included for HealthCorp InfoSec review.

Next steps (proposed):
- Sarah: confirm business sponsor + technical SME (by EOD Thu 7/2)
- Procurement: confirm typical PO timeline and any required contract addenda (by Fri 7/10)
- Redwood (Karthik/Neha): prepare sandbox checklist and prefilled SOC2 evidence link for InfoSec (by Tue 7/6)
- Schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff with all named owners week of 7/6 or 7/13 (I can coordinate a slot once owners confirmed)

If that looks correct I’ll push v1.1 to the Drive link and request a brief MAP kickoff meet next week. Jordan (cc’d) will also add a one-page summary that procurement can attach to the internal PO request to speed approval.

Best — Jordan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
